endorsements.name: Ayoub Nouri
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-1326
endorsements.description: The Homey theme for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized modification of data due to a missing capability check on the homey_reservation_del() function in all versions up to, and including, 2.4.4.
